lost_gear.title: The Stopped Clock
steps: Find the Clockmaker's brass gear somewhere in the forest.
Bring the brass gear back to the Clockmaker in Lanternrest.
lost_gear.done_text: The Big Clock ticks again. Lanternrest remembers what time it is.

pip_home.title: A Light for Pip
steps: Find someone in Lanternrest who knows Pip.
Bring Mira's lantern charm to Pip in the forest.
